about: Price model for kit quote. Bands sit below the managed review services in research/niches/reviews.json service_menu ($149 to $2,500 a month) and near the review software a shop would otherwise pay for ($15 to $125 a month); the exact bands are a judgment call to keep a first offer easy to say yes to. Printing is billed at cost.

packages.label: Review setup
includes: Their own review link and QR code, tested on two phones
Counter card and handout cards, print-ready
Review line for receipts and the thank-you email
The ask for staff, written for their shop
Reply templates for good and bad reviews
Starting count and rating written down with the date
packages.basis: judgment call, below managed services ($149 a month and up, CommentAssist comparison) and agency onboarding ($100 to $500, Praising.ai).

packages.label: Monthly review care
includes: A reply draft for every new review within 1 business day
Fresh cards when they run low
Check the link and the code still work
packages.basis: Sources: managed service $149 a month (CommentAssist); review software $49 to $125 a month (BrightLocal, GatherUp, NiceJob). The band is a judgment call for a first offer.

addons.label: Review text after every visit, sent from their own tool

downsell.label: Review card kit, they print it
includes: Counter card and handout cards with their QR code
downsell.basis: judgment call: a one-time kit for owners who want to do it themselves.
